author: yungmuck
body: Hello! I was recently banned a minute ago for "encouraging suicide" when I was playing walls...I did no such thing I haven't been around nor have I said that to anyone. I do believe this is an error seemings how I was not in the place that is believed it happened in. Thank you.

Thanks,
